gen-fs-oswald-fs-bespoke-serif: Bespoke Serif has a dignified look, its curves swelling faintly like pulled taffy, thin strokes about half the weight of the thick. And Oswald's tightly knit display letters stand over it, confident and strong, while the text serif settles into a paragraph with an authority of its own.
gen-fs-oswald-fs-trench-slab: Tall, tight and sturdy, Oswald holds the top while Trench Slab keeps its lowercase close to the height of its capitals. Oswald is best at bold, compact statements; Trench Slab is best at refined, dignified text.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-bree-serif: Oswald is confident and strong, its display letters packed into tightly knit rows with a modest lowercase height. And Bree Serif feels literary and refined beside it, its outsized lowercase giving the serif a looser, friendlier stride.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-coustard: Coustard brings a classic, bookish text serif, plain and unfussy in its build. Coustard sits comfortably under Oswald's confident, tightly knit display lines, so the two split the page into a loud half and a quiet half.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-crete-round: Oswald leads with confident, strong display letters set in tightly knit rows. But Crete Round, a classic and dignified text serif, can take a slightly larger size than you might expect, since its plain shapes stay quiet.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-eczar: Eczar reads as a traditional, literary text serif, plain in build and settled in tone, the sort of face that lets sentences unspool without fuss. Oswald does its best work shouting confidently; Eczar does its best murmuring.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-esteban: Refined and classic, with a tilt toward the oversized. Oswald delivers confident, tightly knit display punch, while Esteban's text serif lets its wide-open e and barely tapering strokes do the quiet, steady work.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-faustina: Tightly knit rows of confident, strong letters are what define Oswald. Faustina follows with a text serif whose bowls thin gracefully and whose c opens like pliers, so a size slightly above usual would let that softness show.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-goudy-bookletter-1911: Bookish and dignified, this pairing leans on old habits and tight spacing. Goudy Bookletter 1911 packs its characters shoulder to shoulder like rope strands, a serif for steady reading, while Oswald handles the confident, strong display work.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-halant: Compact on top, towering below. Halant is an authoritative, traditional text serif with a faint thick-thin shift and tall lowercase, so it sits next to Oswald's confident, low-set, tightly knit display rows with real presence.
